owner_calls.question: Stage 3 (S3#6, 'Victor learns what has become of Janet') tells only what Victor learns with Stacey; Chase is not part of it. What should happen to it?
options: Drop stage 3; stage 4 (S3#9) already carries the relationship
Drop stage 3 and change stage 4 text to: Victor tells Chase that Janet's mind lives on in the algorithm, and the two work with her to take down Morgan's phone towers.
owner_calls.evidence: In 'Merry Meet Again' (S3#6) Victor offers Stacey to work together, causing Stacey to realize Janet's consciousness survived in the Healing Algorithm; Chase is elsewhere (Max, WIZARD party).
